UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Verified adult user account summary for Watch me Darling without raw PII or client-writable billing entitlements.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

displayName.description: Display name inside Watch me Darling.

contactMethod.description: Primary verification channel used at signup.

verified.description: True once email or mobile SMS verification succeeds.

ageVerified18Plus.description: Must be true confirming user is 18 years or older.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when verified profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

UserPrivateContact.title: UserPrivateContact
UserPrivateContact.description: Strictly isolated PII document storing verified email or mobile phone number.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: Verified email address (empty string if mobile-only).

phoneNumber.description: Verified E.164 mobile number (empty string if email-only).

verifiedMethod.description: Channel through which ownership was verified.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when contact details were updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Verified user account summary keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Owner-only PII subcollection (contact document) isolated from top-level user profiles.
